FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 30
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Steve Livingston
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/14/2023
Senate Bill 30 as introduced exempts Upper Sand Mountain United Methodist Larger Parish,
Incorporated from paying state, county and municipal sales and use taxes, which will decrease
receipts to the following funds by the following estimated annual amounts based on information
provided by the entity:
Education Trust Fund ($19,570)
County Funds ($ 4,900)
Municipal Funds ($19,570)
TOTAL ($44,040)
